$comment: Info.plist text, shown by iOS itself. Keys named like an Info.plist key are used as that key; any other key is a string Info.plist names by value (the quick action), and iOS looks it up by its English text. Follows the phone's (or Settings → Kopiyka → Language) language, never the in-app choice — iOS reads these before the app runs.

CFBundleDisplayName.note: The name under the icon on the home screen. Keep it short.

NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo of a receipt to attach it to an entry. Photos stay on your phone.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kopiyka doesn't record audio. Receipt photos are taken with sound off.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach a receipt you already photographed.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Remember where you log expenses so the category can be suggested next time.
NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Kopiyka only uses your location while the app is open, to suggest the category you used near where you are. It never tracks you in the background.
NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Kopiyka only uses your location while the app is open, to suggest the category you used near where you are. It never tracks you in the background.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Kopiyka doesn't use motion or fitness data.
